name: Number of people employed in an unspecified fisheries or aquaculture subsector
descriptionShort: Number of workers in the primary sector of fisheries and aquaculture who could not be assigned to a specific subsector.
descriptionProcessing: - FAO reports the 2000s and the 2010s as decade averages. We assign that average value to its midpoint year (2005 and 2015, respectively). All other years refer to single years.
